title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: unified alert queue with Triage Agent categorisations
summary: The briefing passes: the documented controls, permissions and licensing statements are supported. It correctly distinguishes the automatic queue replacement from agent configuration, reports the conflicting retirement dates, and leaves the unified view's username behaviour open.

claims.claim: The change brings Data Security Triage Agent categorisations into the standard Insider Risk Management Alerts queue.
claims.quote: With this update, analysts can view agent categorizations alongside traditional alert filters and columns in a single, consolidated workflow.
